_about: A real K1C (firmware 1.3.5.22) finishing a print, as it streamed it on 2026-10-25. The first line is the merged state the printer had sent before the window (marked merged_state). Progress reads 100 while the printer is still printing (state 1, 86 s left), drops back to 99 fifteen seconds later, and only then does the job end: state 2 with progress 100 and no time left, then state 0 about 50 s after. One line per frame, in order; t is seconds since the first frame. Heartbeats, the print history (historyList) and the file listing (retGcodeFileInfo2) removed, hostname anonymised; values otherwise as received, numbers-as-strings included.
